attribution.title: Attribution System

sections.heading: Rare Drops
content: All items with clasification level have a chance of being dropped with attributes. More common items have a very low chance of being looted with an attribute, while particularly rare items have a good chance of having an attribute when dropped. Items can even drop with more than 1 attribute, but this is even rarer. This chance also varies depending on the monster that is defeated, e.g.: you have a higher chance of getting an attributed sword as a drop from a dragon than from a rotworm.

sections.heading: Enchantments
content: To enchant an item with attributes, you need to gather the specific mystic rune. Each item type requires a different rune, (e.g: weapons are enchanted with ember runes, while armors can be enchanted with molten runes). These special runes can be crafted or acquired through mystic bags (dropped by elite monsters). To procced with the enchantment, you also need arcane orbs (consumable resources acquired through the NPC Alexander in Edron). The chance of a sucessfully enchantment is the average chance of all available attributes for that item. You can also choose to use the grand arcane orb which offers a +50% increase in the final enchantment chance.

sections.heading: Attribute Removal
content: Fiery stones could be used to remove the entire enchantment of an item in order to acquire pulverized ores (which are materials for craft mystic runes). The more enchantments an item has, the more ores it can provide when the enchantment is destroyed.

sections.heading: Attribute Protection
content: On death, each item equipped on the character has 20% chance to completely break the enchantment. To protect your item enchantments, you need to acquire the "The Arcane Guardian" bless from the NPCs Eremo or Humphrey. This bless lasts for 10 days, but the time is only counted while in battle and for each attribute equipped on the character, the time decays 10% faster.

exaltationforge.title: Exaltation Forge

sections.heading: Fusion
content: Fusion is the main method of increasing an item's tier through the exaltation ritual. It requires two identical items (including the same tier), crests, gold and a reagent crystal. When two items are successfully fused, a new item of the next tier will be created. However, the chance of success and requeriments needed in fusion varies depending on the item's classification.
To begin the fusion process, you must use a reagent crystal on the item. The target item needs to be inside a container, along with another identical item of the same tier and the respective crests.

sections.heading: Class 5
content: There are also some specific crystals and stones that could be used to enhance the fusion process:

sections.heading: Effect Items
content: Item Effect Rare Crystal Can be used inside the ritual container to enhance fusion success chance by +30%. Prismatic Crystal Can be used inside the ritual container to enhance fusion success chance by +50%. Earth Stone Enchant an item with "earth guard" attribute for 15m. Items enchanted with earth guard will hold it's attributes to apply to the next tiered item in the ritual. Frozen Stone Enchant an item with "frozen guard" attribute for 15m. If the fusion fails, items enchanted with frozen guard will be preserved (it will not break if it is tier 0), and the chance of tier downgrading will be decreased by -50%.

sections.heading: Convergence
content: If an item is classification 4 or higher, you can transfer it's tier to any other item of the same or lower classification, through convergence. Similar to fusion, this process also requires a reagent crystal to be used on the item. To make the convergence, it is necessary the convergence crystal which must be kept together with the item in the same container, exalted cores and gold.

Only two equipments inside the container are allowed in the convergence process, 1 of them must be tier 0 and the other with tier 2 or higher. The convergence has 100% success chance and if the requeriments are meet, the higher tier item will transfer it's tier (minus one) to the another item.

sections.heading: Transcendence
content: Transcendence is a state in which the item surpasses and break its limits, providing improvements to it's currently enchanted attributes for a period of time. The higher is the item's tier, the stronger will be the attributes that exceed its limit through transcendence. However, the requeriments for activate this state also increase.
The transcendence only enhances attributes that is currently enchanted on the item, it does not affect basic stats nor add new attributes.

There are 6 different types of transcendences, each one boosts the power of a specific set of attributes of the item. To transcend your equipment, simply use the corresponding gem on it, and if you have the necessary resources, your equipment will be transcended. Any item can have up to three types of transcendence active simultaneously. If you attempt to transcend with a type that is already active, the duration will just be renewed. The transcendence time is consumed only in battle.
It's also possible to break and remove all transcendences of an item by using Black gems.

sections.heading: Dominion
content: Dominion is an offensive-focused transcendence that pushes an item's combat capabilities beyond its normal limits. It strengthens direct damage and offensive effects while also improving survivability through increased armor, health regeneration, life leech, and fire protection, making Dominion particularly effective for equipment intended for sustained and aggressive combat.

sections.heading: Bastion
content: Bastion is a defensive-focused transcendence that reinforces an item's protective capabilities while improving mana sustain. Its effects increase defense, mana leech and mana regeneration, while strengthening ice-based damage and freezing effects. It also provides additional protection through mana absorption, ice resistance and ice reflection, allowing the wielder to withstand incoming attacks while maintaining resources during prolonged combat.

sections.heading: Sorcery
content: Sorcery is a magic-focused transcendence designed to amplify spellcasting power and mana efficiency. Its effects increase magic level, maximum mana and mana healing, while enhancing energy-based attacks through additional energy damage and electrifying effects. It also strengthens magical defenses by providing protection against energy and mana drain, with the ability to reflect energy damage back at attackers. Sorcery is particularly suited for equipment focused on offensive magic, mana sustain and elemental combat.

sections.heading: Mastery
content: Mastery is a combat-focused transcendence designed to enhance physical proficiency, durability and recovery. Its effects improve melee and distance fighting skills as well as shielding, while increasing maximum health and healing effectiveness. It also empowers poison-based attacks through additional poison damage and poisoning effects, while providing protection against poison and the ability to reflect poison effects back at attackers. Mastery is particularly suited for equipment focused on physical combat, survivability and sustained fighting.

sections.heading: Focus
content: Focus is a precision-focused transcendence designed to maximize the effectiveness and consistency of both physical and magical attacks. Its effects enhance critical hits and critical spells, improve hit chance and attack speed, and strengthen physical damage through perfuration and crushing blows. It also provides additional protection against physical damage, with the ability to reflect incoming physical attacks. Focus further enhances combat flow through momentum and mitigation effects, making it particularly suited for equipment focused on precision, critical strikes and offensive performance.

sections.heading: Supremacy
content: Supremacy is an aggressive transcendence designed to enhance mobility, combat pressure and destructive potential. Its effects increase movement speed while providing abilities such as dodge and vibrancy, alongside powerful offensive bonuses including double bash, berserk and destruction. It also strengthens death and bleeding damage while providing protection against death and other elemental damage, with the ability to reflect elemental effects back at attackers. Supremacy is particularly suited for equipment focused on mobility, relentless aggression and high-impact combat.

exaltationforge.rawTextPreview: Game Features » Exaltation Forge Exaltation Forge Equipments with classification 1 or higher have the possibility of increasing it's tiers. Raising your equipment tier allows it to surpass its limits through transcendence, enhancing it's enchanted attributes for a period of time (more details below)

relicbox.title: Relic Box System

sections.heading: Mission 1 - The Notes of Melchior
content: To learn more about the relic box, seek out Melchior in Ankrahmun. He will ask you to find his old notes in the ruins of the north. Completing this quest will allow him to perform the ritual to open the first and second slots for a certain amount of gold. These rituals, however, last for 48 hours (only counted in battle), and this time is always reseted when a new slot is opened.

sections.heading: Mission 2 - The Djinn War Quest
content: After completing all missions from the Djinn War Quest in any faction, Gabel or Malor will be able to help you to open all relic slots for certain amount of gold. The djinns's rituals also last for 48 hours.

relicbox.rawTextPreview: Game Features » Relic Box Relic Box Miracle created the relic box system to offer additional builds for your character. This box is a container attached to your inventory, which only allows relics. Relics are unique artifacts that can be acquired in the game through creature drops or quests. They ha

playershop.title: Player Shop System

sections.heading: Setting up your shop
content: For add items to your shop, simply drag and drop the item to the shop window or right-click in the item and click on "add to shop" (only items that are in your main backpack and sub-containers can be added; otherwise, you will receive a 'sorry, not possible' message.

You can then setup your items prices, remove or set a default price for some item, right-clicking on them. Remember that the price is always based on the unit, so if you put 100 bolts up for sale, list them for 5gp (not 500gp!). Edit your shop description or leave it without any, then click in "start shop" to start your commerce.
Now you can just click on "idle shop" or exit your client so that your character continues selling items in the game.

playershop.rawTextPreview: Game Features » Player Shop Player Shop Player Shop is a new system that Miracle offers that allow players to create their own trade shop in different areas of the game, transforming your character into a 'NPC' that operates in the game even while you are offline, so any player can visit your store

crafting.title: Crafting Profession

sections.heading: Breaking Items
content: To break an equipment, place the item on top of the anvil and use your iron hammer. If you have enough crafting skill to break that item, It will be destroyed and will provide you some materials, such as steels, draconian steels and hell steels. These materials are extremely necessary for crafting. The higher the classification of an item, it will bring you more valuable materials. Breaking equipments also advance your crafting skill, so it is a good option for training. Items bought from NPC's are also made with a special protection on its metals, so you are not able to break them.

sections.heading: Craftable Items
content: Only blacksmiths are able to craft items. To acquire this profession, find the blacksmith A Sweaty Cyclops in Ab'dendriel. You need at least 20 crafting skill to be promoted. To start crafting items, gather the necessary materials, place them on top of the anvil, and use your iron hammer. The rate for sucessfully craft is 10% + (crafting skill - 10) * item rate.

carpentry.title: Carpentry Profession

sections.heading: Refinement
content: The refinement process involves turning woods into planks, boards and beams for use in carpentry. Once you have the necessary types of wood, look for a carpentry's house in Green Village or Nivandria. Place the required wood onto the machine and use it to refine the material.
